classes.name: Ace Trainer
classes.description: The battle all-rounder who gets the best from any Pokémon.

features.name: Commanding Presence
features.text: Your Pokémon's moves hit 2 percentage points more often.

features.name: Quick Switch
features.text: Once per battle you switch Pokémon for free.

features.name: Second Wind
features.text: Once per battle you may re-roll one of your rolls.

features.name: Critical Eye
features.text: The crit stage of your Pokémon goes up by 1.

features.name: Unbreakable Bond
features.text: Once per battle, a Pokémon that would faint survives at 1 HP.

features.name: Champion's Presence
features.text: Your Pokémon hit 3 percentage points more often, and you roll initiative with advantage.

features.name: Gentle Hands
features.text: Healing items you use heal 25 % more, and your Pokémon gain friendship twice as fast.

features.name: Egg Whisperer
features.text: Eggs you carry hatch twice as fast.

params.text: Eggs hatch twice as fast (egg cycles count double).

features.name: Field Medic
features.text: Once per battle you use an item for free.

features.name: Natural Mender
features.text: At the end of each overworld round your Pokémon recover 10 % of their HP.

params.text: At the end of each overworld round the trainer's Pokémon recover 10 % HP.

features.name: Perfect Care
features.text: Pokémon you hatch get at least 3 good IVs, and your Pokémon get 10 % more XP.

params.text: Hatched Pokémon get at least 3 good IVs.

features.name: Soul Tender
features.text: Once per session you revive a Pokémon to 50 % HP anywhere.

classes.name: Researcher
classes.description: Studies Pokémon to find their weaknesses.

features.name: Field Notes
features.text: You have expertise in Pokémon Lore. At the start of a battle you learn every enemy's type and HP level.

params.text: At battle start the player learns every enemy's type and HP level.

features.name: Weakness Analysis
features.text: Once per battle you reveal an enemy's moves; your next attack on it gets +10 percentage points of accuracy.

params.text: Once per battle reveal an enemy's moves; the next attack on it gets +10 pp accuracy.

features.name: Data Gathering
features.text: You get +10 trainer XP the first time the party meets each species.

params.text: +10 trainer XP the first time the party meets each species.

features.name: Exploit Weakness
features.text: Super-effective hits of your Pokémon do 10 % more damage.

features.name: Encyclopedic Mind
features.text: You may re-roll failed Pokémon Lore, Nature or Investigation checks.

features.name: Perfect Analysis
features.text: Once per battle you suppress an enemy's ability for 3 rounds.

params.text: Once per battle suppress an enemy's ability for 3 rounds.

classes.name: Ranger
classes.description: Scout and explorer; best at travel and catching.

features.name: Pathfinder
features.text: The party's movement roll gets +1, and you have advantage on Survival and Perception.

features.name: Light Step
features.text: Random encounters are 10 percentage points less likely for the party.

features.name: Wild Whisperer
features.text: Your catch chance is multiplied by a further 25 %.

features.name: Swift Retreat
features.text: Your flee chance is 20 percentage points higher, and the whole party escapes on one success.

params.text: The whole party escapes when the Ranger's flee roll succeeds.

features.name: Trailblazer
features.text: The party's movement roll gets 2 more points.

features.name: Master of the Wild
features.text: Once per session you skip an encounter.

params.text: Once per session the Ranger skips an encounter.

classes.name: Hiker
classes.description: Tough mountain traveller; takes the hits.

features.name: Tough as Rock
features.text: You get 1 extra HP per level, and damage dealt to you is reduced by your proficiency bonus.

features.name: Stand Your Ground
features.text: Rock, Ground and Steel Pokémon start battles with +1 Defense.

features.name: Heavy Pack
features.text: Your bag has 10 more slots.

features.name: Bulwark
features.text: Once per battle you take a hit instead of a Pokémon.

features.name: Mountain Stride
features.text: Athletics gates pass automatically, and the party's movement roll gets 2 more points.

params.text: Athletics gates pass automatically for the Hiker.

features.name: Immovable
features.text: Once per session you survive a knock-out at 1 HP.

classes.name: Coordinator
classes.description: Stylish performer; flashy moves and charm.

features.name: Showmanship
features.text: You have expertise in Performance, and shops give you a 5 % discount.

features.name: Appeal
features.text: Once per battle you add a d6 to a damage roll.

features.name: Crowd Favourite
features.text: Your Pokémon gain friendship 1.5 times as fast.

features.name: Combo Master
features.text: Appeal works twice per battle.

features.name: Encore
features.text: When your Pokémon lands a critical hit it heals 10 % of its HP.

params.text: When the trainer's Pokémon crits it heals 10 % HP.

features.name: Grand Festival
features.text: Once per session all your Pokémon in a battle get +1 in every stat.

params.text: Once per session all the trainer's Pokémon in a battle get +1 in every stat.

features.name: Foresight
features.text: Once per round the admin tells you the category and target of an enemy's declared move.

params.text: Once per round the admin reveals the category and target of an enemy's declared move.

features.name: Mind Link
features.text: Party members can use your initiative if it is higher.

params.text: Party members may use the Psychic's initiative if it is higher.

features.name: Calm Mind
features.text: Enemy status effects are 20 percentage points less likely to apply to your Pokémon.

features.name: Precognition
features.text: Once per battle you make an enemy re-roll a hit.

features.name: Psychic Shield
features.text: You have advantage on the defence roll when you are targeted.

params.text: Advantage on the defence roll when the Psychic is targeted.

features.name: Clairvoyance
features.text: You see the whole map (no fog of war) and the species of the next encounter.

params.text: The player sees the species of the next encounter.

features.name: Keen Eye
features.text: You have expertise in Appraisal, and you get 10 % more ₽ from NPC trainers and bosses.

features.name: Haggler
features.text: Buy prices are 5 % lower and sell prices 5 % higher.

features.name: Item Savvy
features.text: Held items are 10 % stronger.

params.text: Held items are 10 % stronger for the trainer's Pokémon.

features.name: Hidden Stash
features.text: Your bag has 5 more slots, and key items do not count.

params.text: Key items do not count against the bag limit.

features.name: Treasure Hunter
features.text: You get 1 extra roll on boss loot.

features.name: Midas Touch
features.text: Buy prices drop to 75 % and sell prices rise to 150 % (in total, with Haggler).

classes.name: Medic
classes.description: Healer who keeps the team standing.

features.name: First Aid
features.text: Healing items you use heal 50 % more, and allies at 0 HP are stabilised automatically.

params.text: Allies at 0 HP are stabilised automatically.

features.name: Triage
features.text: Once per battle you use an item on an ally's Pokémon for free.

features.name: Status Clear
features.text: Once per battle you cure a status condition for free.

params.text: Once per battle cure a status condition for free.

features.name: Field Hospital
features.text: Once per session you heal the party by 50 % at any node.

features.name: Resuscitate
features.text: Up to 3 times per session you revive a Pokémon at 25 % HP without an item.

features.name: Miracle Worker
features.text: Once per session you fully heal the whole party anywhere.
